sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', Player.birthday) AS age
FROM Player
JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id
WHERE Player_Attributes.date BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
  AND Player_Attributes.sprint_speed >= 97
